title: Abafuna Inyaniso Abathobekileyo
intro: Kwilizwe lamandla amandulo nobugqi, kuvela ungquzulwano olukhulu. Elinye icala linegunya lemiqondiso yobuthixo, ngelixa elinye lizama ukufanisa okungenakwenzeka. Isiphumo siya kutshintsha ngonaphakade indlela yembali. Ngaba ungatyhila ubuni babo bayibonayo inyaniso yokugqibela baza bazithoba phambi kwayo?
clues: Sonke sawa phantsi, singakwazi ukukhanyela inyaniso
Saqonda ukuba le miqondiso ivela kuThixo omnye oyinyaniso
Sasiluluntu lokuqala ukwamkela ukholo ngendlela ephawulekayo kangaka
Sathenjiswa iparadesi njengembuyekezo yethu ngenxa yokholo lwethu
Iintambo zethu kunye nezintonga zethu zaba ziinyoka phambi kwamehlo ethu, kodwa sakhetha ukuzithoba

trial.label: Uvavanyo/Isiganeko
options: Umngeni ovela kwinkamela yenkamela yoMprofeti uSalih

arabic: فَأُلْقِىَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ سُجَّدًۭا قَالُوٓا۟ ءَامَنَّا بِرَبِّ هَـٰرُونَ وَمُوسَىٰ
verse: So the magicians fell down in prostration. They said, "We have believed in the Lord of Aaron and Moses." (20:70)
